<script>
(() => {
  const openPublicationLinksInNewTabs = () => {
    const content = document.querySelector("#quarto-document-content");
    if (!content) {
      return;
    }

    content.querySelectorAll('a[href^="http"]').forEach((link) => {
      link.setAttribute("target", "_blank");

      const rel = new Set(
        (link.getAttribute("rel") || "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
      );
      rel.add("noopener");
      rel.add("noreferrer");
      link.setAttribute("rel", Array.from(rel).join(" "));
    });
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", openPublicationLinksInNewTabs, {
      once: true
    });
  } else {
    openPublicationLinksInNewTabs();
  }
})();
</script>
